warning: service qbittorrent: stop_grace_period was dropped: Incus has no per-instance stop timeout
note: service qbittorrent: container_name is ignored: the instance is named for the service, which is the name siblings use
note: service qbittorrent: bind mount /path/to/qbittorrent/appdata is mounted as it is: files owned by a host user show up as "nobody" in the container, so the app can read it but probably not write to it. Add :ro if it only reads, or :shift to map the ids (needs idmapped-mount support on that filesystem)
note: service qbittorrent: bind mount /path/to/downloads is mounted as it is: files owned by a host user show up as "nobody" in the container, so the app can read it but probably not write to it. Add :ro if it only reads, or :shift to map the ids (needs idmapped-mount support on that filesystem)
